services.name: On-Site Rentals
services.desc: Reservations are available all day. Gear includes paddle and life jacket (PFD). We are located on Lake River, a tributary to the Columbia River, within the Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge; McCuddy’s Marina, 5 Mill St., adjacent to the public boat launch in Ridgefield, Washington, 98642. Know before you go! For the safety and enjoyment of our customers, we have recommended weight capacities for our variety of rental equipment. Please call us if you have any questions. Solo Kayaks: 250 lbs Tandem Kayaks: 450 lbs Stand Up Paddle Boards: 240 lbs Canoes: 550 lbs

blurb: Alder Creek Kayak & Canoe offers a wide range of paddle sport rentals suitable for mellow floats or intense multi-day adventures. They have multiple rental locations including Ridgefield, Tualatin, and Jantzen Beach. No prior experience is required at Ridgefield, Tualatin, or Lake Oswego locations, but is recommended at Jantzen Beach.
